# Welcome

This website tracks changes in the registered financial interests of members of the Norwegian Parliament (Stortinget). It automatically detects and highlights changes whenever politicians update their registrations.

## About the data

The data is extracted from Stortinget's official register of financial interests. Each politician's page shows:

- Their **first registered entry** (complete text)
- **Changes over time** displayed as diffs (additions and removals highlighted)

The diffs ignore whitespace changes to focus on meaningful content updates.

## Data source

Official data from Stortinget: <https://www.stortinget.no/no/stortinget-og-demokratiet/representantene/okonomiske-interesser/>
